cases.title: Install and launch the signed HAP
assertions: The ZhuoBrowser window is foreground and interactive

cases.title: Select the current address and keep controls above the keyboard
preconditions: An existing web page is active
steps: Inspect the text field and keyboard-safe layout
assertions: The current URL is fully selected
Cancel and all shortcut controls remain visible

steps: Confirm the active Web URL has not changed
failureSignals: localhost is treated as a search query

cases.title: Insert www after a selected URL scheme
preconditions: The full current URL is selected
assertions: The scheme remains at the beginning

cases.title: Submit non-address input through the search engine

cases.title: Paste text without automatic navigation
preconditions: A controlled clipboard fixture is available
steps: Paste a URL into the omnibox
Observe the active page before submission

results.notes: Fresh install and launch evidence recorded on the connected target.

evidence.summary: hdc install and aa start both completed successfully.

results.notes: The focused TextInput reported selected=true and all controls were visible above the landscape keyboard.

evidence.summary: The existing URL is selected while the keyboard, Cancel, and shortcut strip remain visible.
Fresh UI dump for focused and selected omnibox state.

results.notes: Text injection changed only the field; the IME action then navigated to the HTTP localhost target.

evidence.summary: The field contains localhost:8787 while the active Web node still has the previous URL.
After submission, the tab title is localhost:8787 and the displayed host is localhost.

results.notes: The initial real-device run exposed www.http:// ordering. The implementation was fixed, rebuilt, reinstalled, and rerun successfully.

evidence.summary: The fixed field value is http://www.localhost:8787/.

results.notes: Non-address input was routed to the configured Bing endpoint.
No controlled clipboard injection command was available through the connected hdc shell. Text editing was verified, but it is not claimed as paste evidence.
The initial run exposed hidden actions in wide mode. After the fix, Next focused the URL field and both actions remained above the keyboard. Empty Save also produced recoverable inline validation.

evidence.summary: Wide quick-site editor constrained above the landscape keyboard with actions visible.
The URL input is focused and Cancel/Save are within the visible window.
The invalid URL message is visible without dismissing the editor.

results.notes: The connected target is a 2880x1920 tablet in landscape. Compact handset and rotation evidence were not fabricated.

validation.summary: 166 tests passed with 0 failures and 0 errors after both real-device fixes.
The signed HAP built successfully after both fixes.
The corrected HAP installed successfully on target 45P0225509000207.
